summary: Tested all new features (employer-requests endpoints, /employeurs page + form, /blog list+post, /conditions, FR/EN i18n toggle with localStorage persistence, admin login password eye toggle, admin dashboard 3rd 'Demandes employeurs' tab) plus regression of existing flows. Backend: 33/33 pytest tests pass (extended test_attouna_api.py with 9 new TestEmployerRequests cases covering valid create, sector=autre, invalid sector/urgency/nb (422), 401 without auth, admin list, delete with auth+verify removal+404). Frontend: 12/12 Playwright assertions pass — Blog link in header, FR/EN switch (Accueil↔Home, Offres d'emploi↔Job offers) persisted in localStorage 'attouna_lang' across reload, /employeurs full form submit succeeds with success card visible, /blog renders 4 cards and /blog/:slug renders article body, /conditions has all 8 numbered terms-section-{1..8}, admin-login-password-toggle flips input type password↔text, admin login + tab-employers shows the submitted TEST_Acme request row.

issues: Active tab 'Demandes employeurs' renders nearly invisible in the captured screenshot — the icon and label text appear blanked-out on the active state (other inactive tabs render correctly). Possibly a Tailwind data-[state=active] class conflict with the shadcn TabsTrigger default variant. Low priority — tab is still clickable and content renders correctly.

action_items: (Optional, low priority) Investigate why the active 'Demandes employeurs' tab trigger label/icon appears blank in screenshots — likely a CSS class ordering issue between data-[state=active]:bg-navy/data-[state=active]:text-white and the default TabsTrigger styles in components/ui/tabs.jsx.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py — EmployerRequest endpoints look clean: Pydantic Literal enums correctly produce 422 for invalid sector/urgency, ge=1/le=999 enforces nb_positions, _id is excluded from list responses, status defaults to 'new'. No issues.

EmployersPage.jsx — submit button is correctly disabled until both sector and urgency are set; nb_positions is parsed to int before POST; on success the form is reset to EMPTY and a success card with data-testid='employer-form-success' is shown. Good UX.
AdminLoginPage.jsx — password toggle is implemented with proper aria-label and data-testid; type switches deterministically password↔text. Looks good.

AdminDashboardPage.jsx EmployersManager — handles loading/empty/data states, delete with confirm AlertDialog and reload-after-delete. View dialog renders all relevant fields. Mailto/tel links work. No data leakage of _id.
i18n.jsx — lang persisted via localStorage 'attouna_lang' and confirmed across reload. Toggle button updates header labels live (verified Accueil→Home, Offres d'emploi→Job offers).
Backend has no rate-limiting on POST /api/employer-requests (public endpoint) — could be spammed; consider basic throttling if abuse becomes an issue (non-blocking).
AdminDashboardPage.jsx is now ~715 lines (above 700-line guideline) — consider splitting JobsManager / ApplicationsManager / EmployersManager into separate files for maintainability.
test_credentials: attounaservice@yahoo.com / Attouna2024! (admin) — confirmed working via login + JWT bearer.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 employer-request via /employeurs UI (TEST_Acme_<ts>) — left in DB so admin can verify the tab. Backend test suite created+deleted 2 TEST_ employer-requests, 3 TEST_ jobs, and 1 TEST_John application (all cleaned up via authenticated DELETE).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All employer-requests backend endpoints (POST/GET/DELETE) plus 422 validation work. Frontend i18n FR/EN persists via localStorage 'attouna_lang'. Password eye toggle on /admin/login uses data-testid='admin-login-password-toggle'. Admin dashboard now has 3 tabs: tab-jobs/tab-applications/tab-employers. Only minor visual glitch is the active TabsTrigger appearing blank in screenshots — content/click work fine, so it's purely a styling concern.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. The previously reported issues from iterations 1 & 2 (sector pre-fill on /offres apply buttons, ResizeObserver overlay on admin Select) remain resolved. New employer-requests flow works end-to-end.
